scope: Geometric and raster-pattern identification only; no finite-element solution or identification of the historical computational coefficient arrays.

dataset.name: Marmousi II
dataset.creators: Martin, Wiley and Marfurt; Allied Geophysical Laboratories
dataset.spacing_convention: Nominal 1.25 m from 17000/13600 and 3500/2800; the Madagascar processing example sets 1.249 m. Raster registration does not resolve this difference.

published_problem.error_definition: sqrt(sum(abs(u_ref-u_mhm)**2)/sum(abs(u_ref)**2)); sampled pressure error, not a quadrature-integrated L2 norm

registration.sampling: Bilinear interpolation of native physical fields at raster sample locations; centered, Euclidean-normalized correlations. No physical coefficient scaling or optimization.

interpretation.crop: The fixed-size search supports a central subfield, but the 15 m displacement of the best horizontal origin from the symmetric crop is below one raster pixel.
interpretation.display_association: Figure 6.8 correlates more strongly with density and Figure 6.9 with velocity. This concerns display patterns, not the historical PDE coefficients.
interpretation.uncertainty: Image pixel sizes are localization scales, not confidence intervals. Unknown resampling, antialiasing and pixel-center conventions prevent unique historical 5 m crop identification.
interpretation.reproduction_status: Table 6.1 has not been numerically reproduced from an identified historical material array.
required_historical_inputs: original 2048 by 512 velocity and density arrays
cell versus node association and orientation
sampling convention at macro interfaces and point-source treatment
